statement: For E:y²=x³−1681x, analytic rank, rational rank, and full 2-power Selmer corank are each 2; Sha[2^infty]=0.
hypotheses: Classical modularity/functional equation, Tunnell central-value identity for odd squarefree twists, full rational 2-torsion descent and Monsky formula.
definitions: Kummer map x,x−41,x+41 in rational squareclasses; pure 2-Selmer nullity; completed L= (sqrt(N)/(2pi))^s Gamma(s)L(s).
source_locators: Tunnell doi:10.1007/BF01389327; Monsky appendix to Heath-Brown, Invent Math 118 (1994); https://doi.org/10.1142/S1793042119500362; https://webusers.imj-prg.fr/~pascal.molin/cours/cimpa2016/congruent.html
proof_or_gap: Explicit independent Kummer classes modulo torsion plus zero 2x2 Monsky matrix give rank 2 and Sha[2]=0. Tunnell counts give exact central vanishing; sign +1 gives first derivative zero; rigorously outward-rounded Mellin second derivative bound establishes nonzero second derivative. No BSD assumption used.
implication_to_claim: Independent equality in one genuine rank-two example, beyond the earlier local Euler-factor probes; not general rank comparison.
unproved_dependencies: General higher-rank comparison, other primes of Sha, refined leading-term identity. External theorem hypotheses and arithmetic certificate await independent review.
adversarial_findings: Exact 2-descent alone does not give analytic order; numerical small central value alone cannot prove vanishing. Here separate Tunnell identity and bounded integral address both for one curve.
